selector.rationale: Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos identified in histopathological examination support Cutaneous histoplasmosis

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of characteristic BCC features like palisading or clefting

rejected.label: Cutaneous leishmaniasis
rejected.why: No mention of Leishman-Donovan bodies or other characteristic features

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: No mention of characteristic Sporotrichosis features like sporotrichal lymphocutaneous spread

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of characteristic SCC features like keratin pearls or individual cell keratinization

rejected.label: Cryptococcosis
rejected.why: Although Cryptococcosis is a possibility, the presence of intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos is more characteristic of Histoplasmosis
